content.description: The entire text of the log entry.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the log entry was reported. Logged using {@link DateTime#millis} format.

startLineNum.description:
The line number (1-based) of the log header if read from a file.

@see #endLineNum

title:
Represents a single timestamped log entry in a C3 log, produced by {@link Logger}. This can be any log entry,
not just for actions.
name: Log.EntryBase
